# Token reference

<!-- Generated by packages/apothecary-tokens/scripts/docs.mjs from tokens.json (Apothecary v4). Do not edit by hand; run `yarn tokens:docs`. -->

Every value here compiles to a CSS custom property `--ap-<name>` and, for Tailwind, a utility (`bg-<color>`, `shadow-<name>`, `rounded-<name>`, `type-<style>`). Themes: **Night** (`night`), **Parchment** (`parchment`).

## Color

| Token | Night | Parchment | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface-0` | `#101211` | `#eff1ec` | Page ground. Off-black in Night, so the green cards sit on it, soft sage in Parchment. |
| `surface-1` | `#15261f` | `#fbfcfa` | Cards, list rows, drawers. Holds ink, ink-muted, brass and every *-ink role color at 4.5:1 or better. |
| `surface-2` | `#1e352c` | `#e2e7e0` | Raised surfaces: the tab bar, sheets, icon buttons, tonal buttons. |
| `bottle` | `#2a3b33` | `#2a3b33` | Brand bottle green, identical in both themes. Used sparingly as a feature surface: the summary card on Home, a room hero. Pair only with on-bottle and brass-on-bottle. |
| `line` | `#2b4438` | `#d3dad1` | Default hairline between rows and around inputs. |
| `line-strong` | `#425c50` | `#a9b4ab` | Hover borders and section dividers. |
| `ink` | `#eceeeb` | `#1e2622` | Primary text on any surface. Bone in Night, green-black in Parchment. |
| `ink-muted` | `#a4aaa6` | `#515a54` | Locations, metadata, helper text. 5.3:1 minimum on surface-2. |
| `brass` | `#c9a25e` | `#7a5c24` | The apothecary accent: bin-tag hairlines and numbers, the location tile hover, small icons. Ornament only, never an action. Text-safe on surface-0/1/2. |
| `brass-bright` | `#e2c07f` | `#5e4519` | Hover and pressed state for brass elements. |
| `brass-tint` | `#2e281b` | `#eadcbc` | Fill behind brass text. |
| `sapphire` | `#2a55b8` | `#234a9e` | Jewel blue. The ONE interactive fill: primary buttons, selected tab, links' underline. Pair with on-sapphire. |
| `sapphire-ink` | `#8dadf2` | `#234a9e` | Sapphire as text or icon on a surface: links, active breadcrumb. |
| `sapphire-tint` | `#182a4f` | `#d9e0f0` | Selected tiles and rows, the active tab; behind sapphire-ink. |
| `on-sapphire` | `#f5f6f4` | `#f7f8f5` | Text and icons on sapphire and oxblood fills. |
| `oxblood` | `#8e2f2a` | `#8e2f2a` | Destructive fill (remove item, delete location). Pair with on-sapphire. |
| `oxblood-ink` | `#ec9a90` | `#8e2f2a` | Low-stock and error text on surfaces. |
| `oxblood-tint` | `#3a1b19` | `#f1dad4` | Behind oxblood-ink: the low-stock chip and error banner. |
| `verdigris-ink` | `#7cc2a6` | `#2b6250` | Stocked / confirmed text and icons. |
| `verdigris-tint` | `#1f4d3c` | `#d6e8de` | Behind verdigris-ink: the stocked chip. |
| `on-bottle` | `#eceeeb` | `#eceeeb` | Text on bottle (9.3:1). |
| `brass-on-bottle` | `#c9a25e` | `#c9a25e` | Brass detail on bottle (5.0:1): numerals and captions on feature cards. |
| `focus` | → `sapphire-ink` | → `sapphire-ink` | Focus ring: 2px, offset 2px. Never removed. |

## Typography

Families:

- `display`: "EB Garamond", Georgia, serif
- `sans`: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
- `mono`: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace

| Style | Family | Size / line | Weight | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type-display-2xl` | display | 60px / 60px, -0.015em | 600 | Desktop screen titles (≥960px). On phones the same heading steps down to display-xl. |
| `type-display-xl` | display | 44px / 46px, -0.01em | 600 | Large screen titles: a room, a cabinet, an item. |
| `type-display-lg` | display | 30px / 34px, -0.005em | 600 | Section heroes and container headings. |
| `type-title` | display | 22px / 26px | 600 | Section headings. Never item names in dense lists: those are sans. |
| `type-numeral` | sans | 32px / 32px | 500 | Big counts on location tiles, the stepper and summary cards. Set in Inter so counts line up with the rest of the interface. |
| `type-body` | sans | 15px / 22px | 400 | Running text, item names in lists, form values. |
| `type-body-strong` | sans | 15px / 22px | 500 | Item names, quantities, button labels. |
| `type-meta` | sans | 13px / 18px | 400 | Paths, timestamps, secondary lines. |
| `type-caption` | sans | 12px / 16px | 500 | Status chips, tab labels. Sentence case, no tracking. |
| `type-code` | mono | 12px / 16px | 400 | Bin codes on tags and printed labels. |

## Spacing

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `space-1` | `4px` | Icon-to-label gaps. |
| `space-2` | `8px` | Chip padding, tight stacks. |
| `space-3` | `12px` | Gaps between cards and tiles. |
| `space-4` | `16px` | Card padding. |
| `space-5` | `20px` | Page gutter on phones. |
| `space-6` | `24px` | Between related sections. |
| `space-8` | `32px` | Between major sections; desktop gutter. |
| `space-12` | `48px` | Large breaks. |

Spacing matches Tailwind's 4px scale, so `space-5` is `p-5` / `gap-5`.

## Radius

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `rounded-sm` | `6px` | Bin tags, keyboard hints. |
| `rounded-md` | `12px` | Buttons, inputs, list groups. |
| `rounded-lg` | `20px` | Cards, sheets, feature surfaces. |
| `rounded-pill` | `999px` | Chips, steppers, the tab bar, icon buttons. |

## Depth

Depth is a light source from above: every raised thing has a 1px top highlight and a soft shadow below. Use these tokens; never hand-write a shadow.

| Token | Night | Parchment | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shadow-raised` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff12, 0 1px 2px #00000066, 0 8px 20px -8px #00000099` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff, 0 1px 2px #2a3b331a, 0 8px 20px -10px #2a3b3340` | Cards, list groups, location tiles, panels: anything on surface-1. |
| `shadow-raised-hover` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff1a, 0 2px 4px #00000066, 0 16px 32px -12px #000000b3` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff, 0 2px 4px #2a3b331f, 0 16px 32px -14px #2a3b334d` | Hover and selected state of raised things, paired with a 2px lift. |
| `shadow-sunken` | `inset 0 2px 4px #00000080, inset 0 -1px 0 #ffffff0d` | `inset 0 2px 4px #2a3b331f, inset 0 -1px 0 #ffffffcc` | Wells: the search field and the stepper track. Things you type into or adjust sit below the surface. |
| `shadow-glow` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff33, 0 6px 18px -6px #2a55b8cc` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff40, 0 6px 18px -6px #234a9e99` | Sapphire fills only: the primary button, the add button, the selected tile's ring. |
| `shadow-float` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff14, 0 2px 6px #00000066, 0 16px 40px -8px #000000b3` | `inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff, 0 2px 6px #2a3b331a, 0 16px 40px -10px #2a3b3340` | The floating tab bar. |
| `shadow-dock` | `0 -1px 0 #ffffff0d, 0 -16px 32px -12px #000000cc` | `0 -1px 0 #2a3b331a, 0 -16px 32px -16px #2a3b3333` | Bottom action docks, casting upward over scrolling content. |
| `shadow-sheet` | `0 16px 40px #00000099` | `0 16px 40px #2a3b3329` | Bottom sheets and menus. |

## Layout

Widths that shape pages. Breakpoints are written into media queries as literal values (CSS variables can't be used there); these entries are the source of truth.

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `bp-sm` | `600px` | Small tablets and large phones in landscape: tiles grow, dock buttons size to content. |
| `bp-md` | `960px` | The desktop switch: sidebar replaces the tab bar, split views go two-column, titles use display-2xl. |
| `bp-lg` | `1280px` | Wide desktop: gutters grow to space-12, the detail pane widens. |
| `container-max` | `1200px` | Max width of page content beside the sidebar. |
| `sidebar-width` | `256px` | Desktop sidebar. |
| `pane-width` | `400px` | Desktop detail pane in split views (440px at bp-lg). |
